final.memo:
Our original December 2020 engagement challenged the company’s process leadership, talent retention, and strategic focus [D07]. Under new leadership, the company has implemented the IDM 2.0 program, which fundamentally addresses our concerns regarding manufacturing execution and strategic orientation [D03, D07]. The most recent results show revenue exceeding management's guidance, confirming that the new team is making progress in a complex turnaround [D03].

While the bear case remains—specifically that heavy capital investment will depress free cash flow—the current valuation is compelling [D04, D05]. Trading at approximately 7x EV/EBITDA, the stock prices in a significant level of skepticism, which provides a meaningful cushion while we await proof of long-term engineering success [D04]. The 5.66% free cash flow yield and the newly increased dividend reflect the strength of the underlying cash generation, even during this period of intense spending [D02, D04].

We remain disciplined in monitoring the technical milestones and the capital intensity of the IDM 2.0 roadmap [D03, D07]. We are not currently escalating because management has demonstrably adopted a clear, coherent, and aggressive strategy to restore the business's competitive edge [D03, D07]. We will hold our position to observe the next phases of capacity build-out and customer adoption, ensuring that the company maintains its focus on returns rather than empire-building [D03, D07].
